Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Apple Notes' Image Wand intro - a hand-drawn sketch at the top of the sheet is circled by an Apple Intelligence ring that swirls in, dissolves the sketch, and settles into a glowing gradient ring.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Light onboarding sheet: "Image Wand" title, subcopy, two feature rows, a Continue button. At top center, an illustration stage where the morph loops.

## Motion spec
Pattern: AI morph loop, ~3s.
- A pencil-sketch illustration sits in the stage; a partial arc of the gradient ring (purple to blue, softly glowing) sweeps around it clockwise (~700ms), trailing light.
- As the arc completes a full circle, the sketch dissolves into particles that are absorbed into the ring (300ms), leaving a clean, softly pulsing Apple Intelligence ring.
- The ring holds with a slow luminance pulse (+-15% glow, ~1s half-cycle), then the sequence reverses: the sketch redraws from the ring, and the loop restarts.
- Title, rows, and button stay static; only the stage animates.

## Calibration
- The arc sweep is a comet, not a growing stroke - it has a bright head and a fading tail.
- The dissolve must read as the sketch becoming the ring, not a crossfade between two images.

## Reduced motion
Sketch and ring crossfade (400ms), no sweep or particles.

## Don't miss
- The gradient hues flow around the ring slowly even at rest - a static gradient reads as a border.
- Keep the glow inside the stage bounds; bloom over the title is a leak.
